senses.gloss: m. (ירד, cmp. יָרִיד a. יַרְדֵּן) the large blood vessel, jugular vein (leading from the head to the heart).—Pl. וְורִידִין.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 2:1">Ḥull. II, 1</cite> <he>עד שישחוט את הו׳</he> he must sever the jugular veins; <cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 2:1">Tosef. ib. II, 1</cite>.—
<cite ref="Zevachim 25a">Zeb. 25ᵃ</cite> sq. <he>צריך שׂיתן וו׳ וכ׳</he> he must let the blood of the jugular veins run into the center of the receiving bowl.
<cite ref="Berakhot 8b:6">Ber. 8ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 96a">Snh. 96ᵃ</cite> <he>הזהרו בוו׳</he> be careful in slaughtering that you sever the veins, v. supra; a. e.
